title: Faro Dev · Error & Session Investigation (Provisional)
description: Type-first drilldown from Error Overview. Readable variants → recorded sessions → timeline → raw Loki. Development telemetry only; no production health verdict.

options.content:
### Error → session investigation · Development only

Choose a type in **Error overview**, then read its variants below. Click a **message** to narrow examples and matching sessions, then a **session** → **Client time** → stored record → Explore. “All variants of selected type” clears the message selection.

The selected-type total and variants ignore wallet/session selections. Examples and matching sessions honor the selected variant; the full session timeline does not. No type selected? Error panels are intentionally empty/zero. Wallet lookup and journey activity still work without an error. Counts are records and recorded sessions, not people or a health verdict.

**Timeline limit: oldest 1,000 records in the selected range.** A full table may omit later activity; narrow the time range before drawing conclusions. Error examples show only the newest 20 records.

panels.title: Error records · selected type
panels.description: All exception records of the selected type in app/API mode/version/time/text scope. Ignores variant, wallet and session selections. Zero before choosing a type; not an outage verdict.

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({source="faro"} | logfmt | __error__="" | app_name=${application:doublequote} | app_environment=${environment:doublequote} | app_version=${release:doublequote} | kind="exception" |= ${error_marker:doublequote} | label_format type=`{{ if .type }}{{ .type }}{{ else }}(unknown type){{ end }}` | type=${error_type:doublequote} | type!="__select_group__" [$__range])) or vector(0)

panels.title: Selected type · readable error variants
panels.description: One row per stored hash + exact message within the selected type. Different stacks/messages may still look similar; these are not confirmed distinct bugs. Click the message for matching examples and sessions. Hash remains hidden and is only an internal selector. Long messages can include provider details and request context; inspect full errors below. Narrow the time range if expensive.

targets.expr: sum by (hash, value) (count_over_time({source="faro"} | logfmt | __error__="" | app_name=${application:doublequote} | app_environment=${environment:doublequote} | app_version=${release:doublequote} | kind="exception" |= ${error_marker:doublequote} | label_format type=`{{ if .type }}{{ .type }}{{ else }}(unknown type){{ end }}` | type=${error_type:doublequote} | type!="__select_group__" | keep hash, value [$__range]))

panels.title: Selected error · readable examples
panels.description: Newest 20 matching errors for the selected type and optional message variant, displayed chronologically. Click Client time for full stored details/stack or Session for all activity. Empty until a type is chosen.

targets.expr: {source="faro"} | logfmt | __error__="" | app_name=${application:doublequote} | app_environment=${environment:doublequote} | app_version=${release:doublequote} | kind="exception" |= ${error_marker:doublequote} | label_format type=`{{ if .type }}{{ .type }}{{ else }}(unknown type){{ end }}` | type=${error_type:doublequote} | type!="__select_group__" | hash=~${error_hash:doublequote} | label_format stored_ns=`{{ __timestamp__ | unixEpochNanos }}` | label_format message_summary=`{{ if .value }}{{ .value }}{{ else if .message }}{{ .message }}{{ else if .event_data_reason }}{{ .event_data_reason }}{{ else if .event_data_step }}{{ .event_data_step }}{{ else if .event_name }}{{ .event_name }}{{ else }}{{ .type }}{{ end }}` | line_format `{"timestamp":{{ printf "%q" .timestamp }},"kind":{{ printf "%q" .kind }},"type":{{ printf "%q" .type }},"message_summary":{{ printf "%q" .message_summary }},"session_id":{{ printf "%q" .session_id }},"stored_ns":{{ printf "%q" .stored_ns }}}` | keep app_name, app_environment, app_version, session_id

panels.title: Selected error · matching sessions
panels.description: Matching exception records per recorded session for the selected type and optional message variant. Not unique users. Click a session for all its activity. Empty until a type is chosen.

targets.expr: sum by (session_id) (count_over_time({source="faro"} | logfmt | __error__="" | app_name=${application:doublequote} | app_environment=${environment:doublequote} | app_version=${release:doublequote} | kind="exception" |= ${error_marker:doublequote} | label_format type=`{{ if .type }}{{ .type }}{{ else }}(unknown type){{ end }}` | type=${error_type:doublequote} | type!="__select_group__" | hash=~${error_hash:doublequote} | session_id!="" [$__range]))

panels.title: Wallet lookup · matching sessions
panels.description: Exact, case-sensitive address match in any connected_wallets JSON element, including historical records before disconnect. Independent of error-group/marker selection. Blank address or no matches returns no rows. Click a session for all its signals in the chosen range; counts are matching records, not wallet/user counts.

value.title: Open full session timeline (including after disconnect)

targets.expr: sum by (session_id) (count_over_time({source="faro"} | logfmt | __error__="" | app_name=${application:doublequote} | app_environment=${environment:doublequote} | app_version=${release:doublequote} | session_id!="" | session_attr_connected_wallets!="" | label_format wallet_needle=${wallet_address:doublequote} | wallet_needle!="" | label_format wallet_match=`{{ $found := false }}{{ $needle := .wallet_needle }}{{ range $wallet := fromJson .session_attr_connected_wallets }}{{ if eq $wallet.wallet_address $needle }}{{ $found = true }}{{ end }}{{ end }}{{ $found }}` | __error__="" | wallet_match="true" | keep session_id [$__range]))

panels.title: Journey activity · investigate without an exception
panels.description: Latest 1,000 swap_lifecycle records in application/API mode/version/time, displayed chronologically. Independent of error marker, wallet search and selected session. Click Session for its full timeline. Review attempts, failures/rejections and subsequent progress; no inferred stuck-user or rage-click score. Zero rows means no matching recorded lifecycle data, not proof of healthy behavior.

value.title: Open full session timeline (including after disconnect)

targets.expr: {source="faro"} | logfmt | __error__="" | app_name=${application:doublequote} | app_environment=${environment:doublequote} | app_version=${release:doublequote} | event_name="swap_lifecycle" | session_id!="" | label_format stored_ns=`{{ __timestamp__ | unixEpochNanos }}` | label_format message_summary=`{{ if .value }}{{ .value }}{{ else if .message }}{{ .message }}{{ else if .event_data_reason }}{{ .event_data_reason }}{{ else if .event_data_step }}{{ .event_data_step }}{{ else if .event_name }}{{ .event_name }}{{ else }}{{ .type }}{{ end }}` | line_format `{"timestamp":{{ printf "%q" .timestamp }},"kind":{{ printf "%q" .kind }},"type":{{ printf "%q" .type }},"message_summary":{{ printf "%q" .message_summary }},"event_data_step":{{ printf "%q" .event_data_step }},"event_data_outcome":{{ printf "%q" .event_data_outcome }},"event_data_action":{{ printf "%q" .event_data_action }},"event_data_reason_code":{{ printf "%q" .event_data_reason_code }},"session_id":{{ printf "%q" .session_id }},"event_data_journey_id":{{ printf "%q" .event_data_journey_id }},"event_data_sequence":{{ printf "%q" .event_data_sequence }},"event_data_attempt":{{ printf "%q" .event_data_attempt }},"event_data_source_network":{{ printf "%q" .event_data_source_network }},"event_data_destination_network":{{ printf "%q" .event_data_destination_network }},"traceID":{{ printf "%q" .traceID }},"spanID":{{ printf "%q" .spanID }},"event_name":{{ printf "%q" .event_name }},"stored_ns":{{ printf "%q" .stored_ns }}}` | keep app_name, app_environment, app_version, session_id

panels.title: Session timeline · what happened before and after
panels.description: Choose a session from errors, wallet lookup or journey activity, or paste its ID above. All signals in that session and stored-time range, up to 1,000 records. What happened uses exception value, console message or event-local reason; session metadata is not presented as the event's cause. Same-client-time rows use stored time as a display tie-breaker, not proof of causality.

targets.expr: {source="faro"} | logfmt | __error__="" | app_name=${application:doublequote} | app_environment=${environment:doublequote} | app_version=${release:doublequote} | session_id=${session_id:doublequote} | session_id!="" | session_id!="__select_session__" | label_format stored_ns=`{{ __timestamp__ | unixEpochNanos }}` | label_format message_summary=`{{ if .value }}{{ .value }}{{ else if .message }}{{ .message }}{{ else if .event_data_reason }}{{ .event_data_reason }}{{ else if .event_data_step }}{{ .event_data_step }}{{ else if .event_name }}{{ .event_name }}{{ else }}{{ .type }}{{ end }}` | line_format `{"timestamp":{{ printf "%q" .timestamp }},"kind":{{ printf "%q" .kind }},"type":{{ printf "%q" .type }},"message_summary":{{ printf "%q" .message_summary }},"event_data_step":{{ printf "%q" .event_data_step }},"event_data_outcome":{{ printf "%q" .event_data_outcome }},"event_data_action":{{ printf "%q" .event_data_action }},"event_data_reason_code":{{ printf "%q" .event_data_reason_code }},"session_id":{{ printf "%q" .session_id }},"event_data_journey_id":{{ printf "%q" .event_data_journey_id }},"event_data_sequence":{{ printf "%q" .event_data_sequence }},"event_data_attempt":{{ printf "%q" .event_data_attempt }},"event_data_source_network":{{ printf "%q" .event_data_source_network }},"event_data_destination_network":{{ printf "%q" .event_data_destination_network }},"traceID":{{ printf "%q" .traceID }},"spanID":{{ printf "%q" .spanID }},"event_name":{{ printf "%q" .event_name }},"stored_ns":{{ printf "%q" .stored_ns }}}` | keep app_name, app_environment, app_version, session_id

panels.title: Selected stored record · open Explore for full inspection
panels.description: Select a timeline timestamp. Preserves scope/session, client time, signal kind and stored nanosecond timestamp, avoiding the observed client-time collision. Multiple identical-time matches are still possible; inspect returned rows. Raw logfmt retains stacks/context and any trace IDs. Panel menu → Explore carries query/time/datasource. Tempo is deferred.

targets.expr: {source="faro"} | logfmt | __error__="" | app_name=${application:doublequote} | app_environment=${environment:doublequote} | app_version=${release:doublequote} | session_id=${session_id:doublequote} | session_id!="" | session_id!="__select_session__" | timestamp=${event_time:doublequote} | kind=${event_kind:doublequote} | label_format stored_ns=`{{ __timestamp__ | unixEpochNanos }}` | stored_ns=${event_ns:doublequote} | stored_ns!="__select_event__"
